product_provenance.finding: _aplicar_acuerdo computes per-person verdicts, then writes aggregated r.acuerdo to acuerdo_beto on both roles. Agreement markers in saved entities are row-level unless explicitly scoped as individual; productive code is unchanged.

frame: Only individually proven productive DESACUERDO observations enter sampling and its false-disagreement denominator. Other role agreement, non-evaluable, different-type and untraceable markers are excluded and counted separately.
reconstruction: Uses saved original private input and exact cached NER spans with productive name/overlap rules. Reconstructed productive verdict is separate from suggested technical fragmentation/truncation diagnosis. First entity per role matches productive entidad() behavior.
reading_census: All QC-marked reading rows, not only rows whose displayed motive is disagreement; reconcile per-person counts and file/type disagreement counters. Missing strata and unknown traceability are explicit, never forced to match.
consolidation_census: Single-name logs establish a partial frame. Preserve known logged-name verdicts, coverage/faltants against productive per-person counters, no proof of complete census or invented correspondence to omitted roles.
review_status: Automatic technical suggestions only; manual and human review remain pending.
